pages.text: Tier 3 makes its own power: water from the air, split into hydrogen, heated into plasma, burned in an $(item)MHD Generator$(). The $(item)Ore Washer$() turns raw ore into three washed ore, and the $(item)Circuit Assembler$() makes Plasma Circuits.
The Ore Washer: raw ore and water in, three washed ore out. Granulate them, then smelt: 3x.
